title: ctenopteris flexuosa
intro: Ctenopteris flexuosa, commonly known as the New Zealand fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and fever, due to its health benefits. The plant has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Furthermore, its antioxidant activity may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage, contributing to its potential health benefits.
